svg.aria-label: FloodSight Timeline Spine UI capture annotated in detail: dual-limb hydrodynamic curve, historical evidence event chain, road cut timeline, and synchronized master playhead.

g.text: Pre-Breach Stage Rise + Crest Limit (+206.0 m)

text.tspan: Models upstream lake filling: Pincha flood surge drives reservoir
storage +13.5m past FRL to the +206.0m crest limit (dashed red line).
Pre-breach overtopping begins at T-25m through jammed gate #4 (EVD-14).
At T=0 (06:30 AM), the 336m earthen section fully collapses (EVD-17/18),
releasing ~9,400 m³/s peak surge. Finite-volume 2D SWE solver simulates
downstream wave attenuation and turbulent flood propagation in Cheyyeru.

g.text: Single Source of Truth for Map, Graphs & Tables

text.tspan: Scrubbing or playing past T+495m (02:45 PM) drives the entire interface:
2D SWE inundation depth tiles, river velocity streamlines, road network
connectivity status, and ranked village evacuation schedules sync in real time.
• T-150m (04:00 AM): Upstream Pincha ring bund failure surge (EVD-04)
• T-25m (06:05 AM): Overtopping inception past +206.0m crest (EVD-16)
• T+0m (06:30 AM): Full 336m earthen section washout & collapse (EVD-17)
• T+306m (11:36 AM): Tangaturu inundated; T+435m Kothapirachinpalle hit

g.text: Physical Transportation Severance Precedes Settlement Flooding

text.tspan: Standard hydrodynamic models only report when flood water touches villages.
FloodSight dynamically solves road graph connectivity: access routes and
bridges are severed hours ahead of local flooding, defining the genuine survival
deadline before populations are completely isolated.

g.text: From Storm Inception (T-180m) to Valley Recession (T+1440m)

text.tspan: Emergency response teams can scrub backward to inspect reservoir filling,
pause at breach zero-hour to analyze cross-sectional flood velocity vectors,
or scrub forward to forecast exactly when the surge wave exits the valley reach,
delivering end-to-end tactical clarity for relief operations.
